title: Quality text primitives: Korean and English containment, 8-어절 run hashing and sentence splitting

title: Quality metrics M1–M4, bands, verdicts and rule texts as pure code
goal:
Given documents, nouns and a published window, internal/quality computes every per-post and account value.
- An uncomputable value is absent, never zero.
- Each metric gets one of four verdicts against the product's own bands and minimums.
- Each over-band metric renders its one rule text naming the measured string.
scope:
metrics.go:
- The canonical metric ids per R3.
- M1 per R17 runs over the content titles (never posts.title) of the last 100 published posts. The candidates are the union of their stored nouns; ties go to the longer noun, then lexicographic order.
- M2: the per-post share, plus the account median over the last 20, each measured against its 20 most recent others. The named run per R18 is the one standing in the most of the 20; ties go to the longer run, then the earliest.
- M3 per R19, absent without nouns.
- M4 per R20: NFC rune count; photos are IMAGE blocks with a file; distinct types among the six; average sentence length over TEXT only (Korean runes, English words).
- A median helper ignores absent values.
limits.go (R21): the QUAL-11 bands; the minimums (M1 10, M2 3, M3 1, M4 3); the windows (100 and 20); run length 8; measure_version. A test pins the values.

verdict.go:
- Account verdicts are OVER_BAND, WITHIN_BAND, BELOW_MINIMUM and ABSENT, with the minimum checked against the published count.
- M3 is over band when repetition > 8% or title relevance < 50%.
- Per-post verdicts: M3/M4 against bands only; M2's is BELOW_MINIMUM while the account has fewer published posts other than this one than M2's minimum.
- An absent value neither passes nor warns (QUAL-12, QUAL-40).
rules.go: one Korean and one English rule text per metric (QUAL-13). M1 names its noun and M2 names its run (QUAL-14). An account with nothing published names nothing (QUAL-15).
An import test: internal/quality imports no llm, provider, usage or job package (QUAL-16).
Tests: tables per metric; the tie rules; below minimum versus absent; M3's combined badge; M4's minimum of 3; the rendered texts in both languages.
Verify with ARCH-26 including gofmt.
out_of_scope: density, length or character targets, alt or heading checks, and index prediction (QUAL-28)
a commercial keyword dictionary for M1 (QUAL-32)

title: The daily per-분야 phrase extraction and refresh pass

scope:

title: ② marks replacement spans over the title, tags and body, and taking one is a manual edit
goal: Stored candidates render as pressable marks while their source still stands at that surface and index. A press lists up to 3 phrases. Taking one writes through the ordinary content save with no provenance. A published post shows no marks.
scope:
entities/post: PostDraft.replacementCandidates, mapped through a ReplacementSurface walk test with no default. model/replacements.ts is pure (no React, ARCH-18).
- visibleSpans(content, candidates) uses the same strict index as the server: TITLE is content.title containing the source; TAG is tags[index] containing it; BODY is blocks[index] as a TEXT (not a slot), HEADING or QUOTE block containing it, or a LIST with an item containing it.
- Only the first occurrence is marked, and overlaps are dropped in answer order. A stale candidate drops silently (GEN-53), and phrases are capped at 3 (GEN-54).
- applyReplacement(content, span, phrase) is pure too. A tag phrase that would canonically duplicate another tag is not offered.

entities/post/ui/BlockList.tsx: a renderText seam for the title, tag chip text, TEXT/HEADING/QUOTE content and LIST items. It is the identity by default, so the export preview shows no marks. Tag chips grow to 44 px under pointer-coarse (THEME-23, R37).

- Taking a phrase is setContent(applyReplacement) through the existing content queue and expected revision. It gets the same revision increment, the same return to review and the same learning eligibility, and nothing records provenance (POST-80).
- No marks appear on a published post or when there are no candidates (R39).
